item.text:
The ResStock 2025 Release 1 heat pump water heater upgrade assumes **240V equipment with a uniform energy factor (UEF) of at least 3.3 and a first-hour rating (FHR) of at least 45 gallons/hour**. **120V units are explicitly excluded**, even though some qualify for ENERGY STAR. See the report’s [Technology Summary and Introduction, p. 2](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96826.pdf#page=10).

For the actual simulations, the report specifies higher UEF values by tank size: **3.78 for 50 gallons, 3.95 for 66 gallons, and 3.98 for 80 gallons**. See [Table 3, p. 4](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96826.pdf#page=12).
